annotations.title: Search state and local bids and contracts

description:
State, county and city government bids and contracts (not federal awards), from the
    governments that publish them as open data: Los Angeles (the City, LA County, LADWP, LAUSD,
    airports, port, Metro), New York City, San Francisco, Washington DC, Chicago, Cook County,
    Austin, Detroit, Richmond, Sacramento, Baton Rouge, Montgomery County MD, Delaware, Texas DOT,
    California state departments (Cal eProcure), SUNY construction, E-Rate and others.
    kind: "open" (taking responses, soonest due first), "planned" (forecasts: TxDOT's planned
    lettings, Illinois CDB, San Diego County), "awarded" (contracts first awarded in the last
    year: who won, net amounts) or "current" (in force today, soonest ending first: the re-bids).
    q: words in the title or description; state: two-letter code (open and planned bids);
    source: one source key from the reply's sources. Coverage is partial: no tool has every
    state, county and city; say so when the place asked about isn't covered. Each row links to
    the government's own record (source_url).

kind.description: open (taking responses, soonest due first), planned (forecasts), awarded (contracts first awarded in the last year) or current (in force today, soonest ending first).
